program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to context-conditioned relation frontier
question: Does a fixed-capacity context state built from the previous and current learned motifs resolve the external relation ambiguity that remained after distributional multi-step composition?
hypothesis: Reuse the exact verified external sources, 60/40 split, 512-motif representation learner, and non-overlapping motif stream from the sealed relation experiments. Build exactly 512 context states from training prefixes only: the 511 most frequent ordered (previous motif,current motif) pairs receive dedicated state IDs and all remaining pairs share one overflow state. Train a 512x512 context-state -> next-motif count matrix. On untouched suffixes, the context-conditioned predictor will improve pooled top-1 accuracy by at least 0.01 and code accuracy by at least 0.01 over the sealed current-motif-only relation control, without materially degrading structured or technical-prose accuracy.

portfolio_context.frontier: external raw bytes -> learned motif representation -> context-conditioned source-derived relation
portfolio_context.reason_for_gate: Distributional composition removed greedy state-collapse loss, but depth-3 code remained slightly below unigram. The remaining hypothesis is relation-state ambiguity rather than uncertainty propagation.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Preserving probability mass fixed most depth loss; residual code weakness points to ambiguous one-motif state identity.

scope_statement: This is a one-step context-state holdout gate. It tests whether a previous+current raw-motif context improves relation identity at fixed predictive counter capacity. It does not yet claim successful multi-step context composition.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.sources: same exact three-source SHA-256 manifest as relation R1
frozen_reuse.split: first floor(0.60*N) bytes of each source for all training; final 40% suffixes scoring-only
frozen_reuse.motif_stream_decode: byte-for-byte non-overlapping exact-motif scanner from relation R1
frozen_reuse.source_boundaries: reset motif history and never create pairs or transitions across sources

context_state.training_pair_definition: every ordered adjacent motif pair (previous,current) in decoded training-prefix streams
context_state.selection: rank distinct pairs by occurrence count descending, then previous motif ID ascending, then current motif ID ascending
context_state.mapping: selected pairs map to IDs 0..510 in frozen rank order; every unselected or unseen pair maps to ID 511
context_state.prediction: argmax successor count for the context row; ties choose lowest motif ID; zero-row fallback uses the same pooled training successor unigram argmax as relation R1

control.identity: sealed current-motif-only relation-R1 predictor reconstructed from the same prefixes
control.purpose: paired same-data control; it does not feed context predictions

diagnostic_metrics: training pair coverage captured by dedicated contexts
per-source context and current-only top-1 accuracy
pooled context and current-only top-1 accuracy

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and context improves pooled or code accuracy, but one or more frozen improvement/nondegradation thresholds fail.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but context does not improve either pooled or code accuracy over the current-only control.
classification_rules.invalid: Any authority, source identity, split contamination, representation drift, pair-selection drift, predictive-capacity drift, determinism, or host-isolation criterion fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Authority, source retrieval, or hosted compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed distributional-composition parent and North Star identities match.
A fresh CKB-plane READY_RESEARCH receipt is bound to this exact preregistration commit and frozen external manifest.
All representation learning, motif decoding, source splitting, current-only control construction, unigram fallback, and source-boundary behavior match sealed relation R1.
Only training-prefix motif pairs determine the 511 dedicated contexts; suffix motifs never affect selection, mapping, counts, thresholds, or stopping.
Context predictor uses exactly 512 rows and 512 successor columns; no dynamic row creation occurs.
Current-only control and context predictor score the same suffix triples.
Full Go regression passes before the probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter external sources, hashes, 60/40 split, motif representation, motif decoding, 511+1 context budget, pair ranking, overflow mapping, predictor capacity, fallback, control, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority requirements after any primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: compose the supported fixed-capacity context relation over depth two and three while preserving probability mass and the 512-state context budget

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute failure to overflow collisions versus genuinely non-Markov local context before changing capacity or adding semantic structure
